# `date_diff`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the number of days from `startDate` to `endDate`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
date_diff(endDate, startDate)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- date_diff, example 1
> SELECT date_diff('2009-07-31', '2009-07-30');
1
```

```sql
-- date_diff, example 2
> SELECT date_diff('2009-07-30', '2009-07-31');
-1
```
